description: The scenes both rigs draw from the fixtures, by the same names: tests/parity/desktop.py for Baude, android/.../screenshots/Parity.kt for the phone. chat scenes open fixtures/sessions.json's first session with only the first `lines` lines of its transcript (all of them when absent); `open` opens every tool call's input and output where the app can. `inventory` names the schema/ui entries the scene shows.

scenes.name: home
scenes.what: The sessions list, no chat open

scenes.name: chat-bash
scenes.what: A failed command with its output, after thinking

scenes.name: chat-bash-open
scenes.what: The same, its input and output opened

scenes.name: chat-read-search
scenes.what: Read, Grep and Glob in a row

scenes.name: chat-markdown
scenes.what: A reply with bold, a table and a code block

scenes.name: chat-edit-write
scenes.what: An Edit (a diff) and a Write (a file)

scenes.name: chat-end
scenes.what: The whole chat, at its end

scenes.name: menu
scenes.what: The chat's main menu open (☰ on the desktop)

scenes.name: changelog
scenes.what: The changelog of the running version

scenes.name: panel-meta
scenes.what: The fixture chat with the side panel's Meta page

scenes.name: chat-queued
scenes.what: A turn running, a message written meanwhile queued under the chat, its buttons shown

scenes.name: chat-host-down
scenes.what: The chat's host can't be reached: the banner, something written in the box, send off
scenes.draft: Does the bench need it too?
